## Objective

This report validates the final pooled processing output at student level.

## Load Data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)

resolve_pooled_path <- function() {
  candidates <- c(
    "proc/output/pooled_data.rds",
    "output/pooled_data.rds",
    "../proc/output/pooled_data.rds",
    "../../proc/output/pooled_data.rds"
  )

  hits <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    stop(
      "pooled_data.rds not found. Tried: ",
      paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  normalizePath(hits[1], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

pooled_path <- resolve_pooled_path()
db <- readRDS(pooled_path)

if (!"study" %in% names(db)) {
  stop("Column 'study' is required in pooled_data.rds for this validation report.")
}

if (!"label_country" %in% names(db)) {
  stop("Column 'label_country' is required in pooled_data.rds for this validation report.")
}

# Ensure expected types for reporting.
db <- db |>
  mutate(
    study = as.numeric(study),
    label_country = as.character(label_country)
  )

render_kable_scroll <- function(df, caption, digits = NULL, max_height = "420px") {
  tbl <- knitr::kable(
    as.data.frame(df),
    format = "html",
    caption = caption,
    digits = digits,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    tbl <- kableExtra::kable_styling(
      tbl,
      full_width = FALSE,
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      fixed_thead = TRUE
    )
    tbl <- kableExtra::scroll_box(tbl, width = "100%", height = max_height)
  } else {
    tbl <- htmltools::div(
      style = paste0(
        "overflow:auto; max-height:", max_height,
        "; border:1px solid #d9d9d9; padding:6px;"
      ),
      htmltools::HTML(as.character(tbl))
    )
  }

  tbl
}
```

## 1. Pooled Database Dimensions

```{r}
dimensions <- tibble(
  n_rows = nrow(db),
  n_columns = ncol(db),
  object_size_mb = round(as.numeric(object.size(db)) / 1024^2, 2)
)

render_kable_scroll(dimensions, "Dimensions of the pooled database", max_height = "260px")
```

## 2. Countries by Year and Total Number of Countries

```{r}
countries_by_year <- db |>
  filter(!is.na(study), !is.na(label_country), label_country != "") |>
  distinct(study, label_country) |>
  arrange(study, label_country) |>
  group_by(study) |>
  summarise(
    countries = paste(label_country, collapse = "; "),
    n_countries = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(study)

render_kable_scroll(countries_by_year, "Countries by year and number of countries", max_height = "360px")
```

## 3. Statistical Distribution of Student-Level Variables

### 3.1 Frequencies for Qualitative Variables

```{r}
id_vars <- c("idstudent", "idschool", "idcountry")

is_qualitative <- function(x, nm) {
  if (nm %in% id_vars) return(FALSE)
  if (is.character(x) || is.factor(x) || is.logical(x)) return(TRUE)
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
    ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
    return(length(ux) <= 12)
  }
  FALSE
}

qual_vars <- names(db)[map2_lgl(db, names(db), is_qualitative)]

freq_table <- function(data, var) {
  data |>
    mutate(value = as.character(.data[[var]])) |>
    mutate(value = if_else(is.na(value), "NA", value)) |>
    count(value, name = "n", sort = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      variable = var,
      pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2)
    ) |>
    select(variable, value, n, pct)
}

if (length(qual_vars) == 0) {
  qualitative_frequencies <- tibble(note = "No qualitative variables detected by current rule.")
} else {
  qualitative_frequencies <- map_dfr(qual_vars, ~ freq_table(db, .x))
}

render_kable_scroll(
  qualitative_frequencies,
  "Frequencies for qualitative variables",
  max_height = "420px"
)
```

### 3.2 Summary Statistics for Quantitative Variables

```{r}
is_quantitative <- function(x, nm) {
  if (nm %in% id_vars) return(FALSE)
  if (!(is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x))) return(FALSE)
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  length(ux) > 12
}

quant_vars <- names(db)[map2_lgl(db, names(db), is_quantitative)]

safe_skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3) return(NA_real_)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  m <- mean(x)
  mean(((x - m) / s)^3)
}

safe_kurtosis <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 4) return(NA_real_)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  m <- mean(x)
  mean(((x - m) / s)^4) - 3
}

if (length(quant_vars) == 0) {
  quantitative_summary <- tibble(note = "No quantitative variables detected by current rule.")
} else {
  quantitative_summary <- tibble(variable = quant_vars) |>
    mutate(
      n_non_missing = map_int(variable, ~ sum(!is.na(db[[.x]]))),
      mean = map_dbl(variable, ~ mean(db[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      median = map_dbl(variable, ~ median(db[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      sd = map_dbl(variable, ~ sd(db[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
      min = map_dbl(variable, ~ suppressWarnings(min(db[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE))),
      max = map_dbl(variable, ~ suppressWarnings(max(db[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE))),
      kurt = map_dbl(variable, ~ safe_kurtosis(db[[.x]])),
      sk = map_dbl(variable, ~ safe_skewness(db[[.x]]))
    ) |>
    mutate(across(c(mean, median, sd, min, max, kurt, sk), ~ ifelse(is.infinite(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
}

render_kable_scroll(
  quantitative_summary,
  "Distribution statistics for quantitative variables",
  digits = 3,
  max_height = "420px"
)
```

## 4. NA Distribution per Variable (n, %, and % by Year)

```{r}
na_overall <- tibble(variable = names(db)) |>
  mutate(
    n_na = map_int(variable, ~ sum(is.na(db[[.x]]))),
    pct_na = round(100 * n_na / nrow(db), 2)
  )

na_by_year <- map_dfr(names(db), function(v) {
  db |>
    group_by(study) |>
    summarise(
      variable = v,
      pct_na_year = round(100 * mean(is.na(.data[[v]])), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) |>
  mutate(study = paste0("pct_na_", study)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = pct_na_year)

na_variable_distribution <- na_overall |>
  left_join(na_by_year, by = "variable") |>
  arrange(desc(pct_na), variable)

render_kable_scroll(
  na_variable_distribution,
  "NA distribution per variable: n, %, and % by year",
  digits = 2,
  max_height = "420px"
)
```

## 5. NA Distribution by Country (Total and by Year)

The country-level NA distribution is computed over analysis variables only:
contact, peaceful, sign, spray, trafic, occupy, gini, parents_hisced, gender, civic_test, weights.

```{r}
analysis_vars <- c(
  "contact", "peaceful", "sign", "spray", "trafic", "occupy",
  "gini", "parents_hisced", "gender", "civic_test", "weights"
)
analysis_vars <- analysis_vars[analysis_vars %in% names(db)]

if (length(analysis_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No analysis variables found for country-level NA distribution.")
}

country_year_na <- db |>
  filter(!is.na(label_country), label_country != "", !is.na(study)) |>
  group_by(label_country, study) |>
  summarise(
    n_students = n(),
    n_cells = n() * length(analysis_vars),
    n_na_cells = sum(is.na(as.matrix(across(all_of(analysis_vars))))),
    pct_na_cells = round(100 * n_na_cells / n_cells, 2),
    n_students_any_na = sum(if_any(all_of(analysis_vars), is.na)),
    pct_students_any_na = round(100 * n_students_any_na / n_students, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(label_country, study)

country_na_total <- country_year_na |>
  group_by(label_country) |>
  summarise(
    years_participating = paste(sort(unique(study)), collapse = ", "),
    n_years = n_distinct(study),
    n_students = sum(n_students),
    n_cells = sum(n_cells),
    n_na_cells = sum(n_na_cells),
    pct_na_cells = round(100 * n_na_cells / n_cells, 2),
    n_students_any_na = sum(n_students_any_na),
    pct_students_any_na = round(100 * n_students_any_na / n_students, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(label_country)

render_kable_scroll(
  country_na_total,
  "NA distribution by country (total over participating years)",
  digits = 2,
  max_height = "420px"
)
```

```{r}
render_kable_scroll(
  country_year_na,
  "NA distribution by country and year",
  digits = 2,
  max_height = "420px"
)
```
